items.q: Which is better, Charlottenburg Palace or Sanssouci?
items.a: **Charlottenburg is better for a compact Berlin half-day; Sanssouci is better for a full palace-and-park day.** Choose Charlottenburg when you have around four hours, want less walking or need to keep the evening free. Choose Sanssouci when the palace landscape is the main reason for the trip and you can protect six to eight hours.

items.q: How long do you need at Charlottenburg Palace?
items.a: **Allow about three hours on site for one interior and the formal garden, plus roughly one hour total travel from central Berlin.** If you want both the Old Palace and New Wing, add time and check which rooms are open on your date. The free garden gives you the easiest flexible finish.

items.q: How long do you need for Sanssouci from Berlin?
items.a: **Allow six to eight hours from central Berlin and back.** Public transport from Alexanderplatz is usually around 65 to 75 minutes each way, then you still need time for a timed palace entry and a long park walk. A three-hour window is not a realistic Sanssouci day.

items.q: How much are Charlottenburg Palace tickets?
items.a: **A single adult ticket for the Old Palace or New Wing is currently 12 euros, and the charlottenburg+ day ticket is 19 euros.** The combined ticket includes a fixed entry time for the Old Palace. The palace garden is free. Check the official SPSG page because individual buildings can close.

**A single adult ticket for Sanssouci Palace is currently 14 euros, and the sanssouci+ combined ticket is 22 euros.** Sanssouci Palace uses timed admission and is subject to availability. The park is free, so do not buy a combined ticket unless another open building fits your route.

items.q: Can you visit Charlottenburg Palace and Sanssouci in one day?
items.a: **You can connect them, but I would not recommend it for a normal tourist day.** The transfer, two timed interiors and Sanssouci park distances turn the day into transport and deadlines. Choose one palace landscape and experience it properly.

**Yes. Sanssouci Park is free and normally open from 08:00 until dark.** A voluntary shuttle normally operates from April to October between 11:00 and 17:30, but it is not guaranteed and may stop in heavy rain. Plan a walk you can complete without it.

items.q: Is Charlottenburg Palace open on Mondays?
items.a: **The palace interiors are normally closed on Mondays.** From April to October, the Old Palace and New Wing generally open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 17:30, with last admission 30 minutes before closing. The garden remains open daily from 08:00 until dark.
